mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UserLocationLatest (email, location_name, latitude, longitude, recorded_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{locationName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE location_name = VALUES(location_name), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), recorded_at = NOW();
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, location_name, latitude, longitude, recorded_at FROM UserLocationLatest WHERE email = #{email} AND recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY UNION ALL SELECT id, email, location_name, latitude, longitude, recorded_at FROM UserLocation WHERE email = #{email} AND recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserLocationLatest WHERE email = #{email}) ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM UserLocationLatest WHERE recorded_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY;
DELETE FROM UserLocation WHERE recorded_at < NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY;
